110 text Awarded to teams that have shown excellence, beyond what is required for Silver, across General Bio Engineering and their chosen Specializations.
117 text Individual judges evaluate the work documented on the Standard URL on team wikis (and on the relevant Registry entries, where applicable).
123 text Ties are ruled in favor of the team (for example, three yes votes and three no votes means the criterion is met).

134 text Gold (new in 2026) : the criterion is assessed through the three Special Awards the team selected on the Judging Form. Judges do not cast a separate Gold vote. Each judge already scores those awards on their rubrics, and that judge's yes/no for an award is inferred from their score:  yes  if the score meets the performance standard,  no  otherwise. These votes are then counted in exactly the same way as above. Each of the three selected awards must reach a final result of yes for the Gold criterion to be met.
